rows.grounds: instrumental plural of mūrtipa, a compound of mūrti and pa, denoting guardians or protectors of the image
indeclinable postposition governing the instrumental, indicating accompaniment

items.question: Whose accompaniment frames the previously stated inauspicious portents during the ritual context?
premises: The term mūrtipaiḥ denotes the image-guardians in the instrumental plural.
The indeclinable saha marks accompaniment with the instrumental case.
This phrase connects the prior ominous signs to the presence of the image-guardians.
items.inference: The previously described inauspicious portents are to be understood as occurring together with the image-guardians.
uncertainties: The exact ritual role and identity of the mūrtipas in this specific passage is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Together with the guardians of the images.
